QUOTE: "Every front end therefore asks which languages are compiled in (`clew/substrate.py`: `compiled_languages`, `has_language`, `missing_languages`)." and "The gate prevents that by resolving the route to no grammar." and "The not-indexed report ... stamps at build time which in-scope file types have no rows."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that an installation without the grammars still builds, that a capability gate runs before routing, and that the skipped file types are reported as not indexed.
